addable: Bagel is not in this server yet.
description: These are the servers you own or can manage. Pick one and Discord will ask you to confirm before Bagel joins.
elsewhere: This server is linked to another Twitch channel. Ask that channel's owner to choose Disconnect on this server's Settings page in Bagel first.
emptyBody: Bagel can only be added to a server you own, or one where you have Manage Server. Ask its owner, or create your own server first.
emptyTitle: No server we can add Bagel to
help: Picking a server opens Discord's confirm screen. When you choose Authorize there, Bagel joins that server and sets it up.
mine: Bagel is already in this server.
privacy: We asked Discord for your server list to build this page. That list is used once, here, and is never stored.
title: Servers you manage
missingHint: Server missing? You need the Manage Server permission on it.
repair: Bagel needs to be added again to work in this server.
permissions: Discord lists the permissions Bagel asks for. Keep them all checked: Bagel uses Kick Members, Ban Members and Timeout Members for moderation, and Manage Roles and Manage Channels to set up your server. It never needs Administrator.
